title: BDB Role Definition
description: Typed role definition for Startcycle v2 multi-agent teams.

id.description: Unique role identifier (snake_case, lowercase alphanumeric and underscore only).

role.description: Functional pipeline category for this role.

persona.description: Inline persona instructions and system prompt for the role.

personaFile.description: Path to a markdown persona file (relative or absolute).

skills.description: Skills available to this role, matching directory names under skills/.

playbooks.description: Playbooks attached to this role, either as string IDs or { id, phase } objects.

tools.description: Tools or binaries allowed for this role.

gates.description: Quality gates this role owns or participates in.

model_tier.description: Model capability tier mapping to pipeline.json/AGENTS.md tiers.
